name: white and red striped stone lighthouse with lantern room and gallery
label: pirate-isles/pi-lighthouse

answer.main_body: lighthouse tower with conical roof and gallery
answer.evidence: The structure is drawn in 3/4 perspective: the conical roof shows its southward-facing slope across 10 rows (rows 0-9), the gallery walkway/deck is visible from above (rows 21-24), and the base foundation plinth shows its top horizontal surface (rows 86-89) stepping down to the front vertical base.

answer.main_body: lighthouse tower with gallery platform and lantern
answer.evidence: The conical roof slopes toward the camera (rows 0-9), the gallery deck shows 4 pixel rows of elliptical top surface (rows 21-24), and the base plinth displays a 3-4 pixel row top ledge (rows 86-89), properly establishing the 3/4 top-down angle.

The gallery walkway floor (rows 21-24) is clearly viewed from above showing 4 rows of horizontal surface within the railing ellipse, and the base plinth also shows 3-4 rows of visible top surface (rows 86-89).

The main tower body (rows 31-86) and its conical roof are rendered in pure front architectural elevation: all stripe boundaries, window sills/lintels, the roof bottom rim (row 9), and the gallery underside (row 30) are perfectly flat horizontal lines with zero cylindrical curvature, showing no top surface for the main shaft.
